title: (RHBA-2013:1510) Red Hat OpenStack 3.0 bug fix and enhancement advisory
portal_summary:
Updated packages that fix various bugs and add enhancements are now available
for Red Hat OpenStack 3.0 ("Grizzly"). Technical Notes for the 3.0 release can
be found here:
https://access.redhat.com/site/documentation//en-US/Red_Hat_Enterprise_Linux_OpenStack_Platform/3/html/Technical_Notes/index.html
portal_synopsis: Red Hat OpenStack 3.0 bug fix and enhancement advisory
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenStack Platform|Red Hat OpenStack|grizzly|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously-released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via the Red Hat Network. Details on how to
use the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
https://access.redhat.com/site/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat OpenStack provides the facilities for building a private or public
infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS) cloud running on commonly available physical
hardware. Services provided by these packages include:

* OpenStack Compute service ("Nova").
* OpenStack Image service ("Glance").
* OpenStack Identity ("Keystone").
* OpenStack Networking service.
* OpenStack Object Storage service ("Swift").
* OpenStack Volume service ("Cinder").
* OpenStack Dashboard ("Horizon").
* OpenStack Metering service ("Ceilometer") - Technology Preview.
* OpenStack Orchestration service ("Heat") - Technology Preview.

Red Hat OpenStack also includes these supporting technologies:

* PackStack, a utility for rapidly deploying proof of concept OpenStack clouds.
* Open vSwitch, an implementation of the OpenFlow protocol for remote per-flow
control of network traffic.
* A modified Red Hat Enterprise Linux kernel with network namespaces enabled, to
provide support for advanced network configurations.

For information on the scope and support implications of the Technology Preview
designation applied to some included components refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/support/offerings/techpreview/

To learn about each of the components provided and the way they interact to form
a working cloud computing environment refer to the Release Notes document:

https://access.redhat.com/site/documentation/en-US/Red_Hat_Enterprise_Linux_OpenStack_Platform/3/html/Release_Notes/index.html

These updated Red Hat Enterprise OpenStack packages fix various bugs.
Documentation for these bug fixes is available in the
Technical Notes document:

https://access.redhat.com/site/documentation//en-US/Red_Hat_Enterprise_Linux_OpenStack_Platform/3/html/Technical_Notes/chap-RHBA-2013-1510.html

Major New Features:

The Red Hat Support plug-in for Red Hat OpenStack is a Technology Preview
feature which offers seamless integrated access to Red Hat subscription services
from the Red Hat OpenStack administration portal. The plug-in provides automated
functionality that enables quicker help, answers, and proactive services. It
offers easy and instant access to Red Hat exclusive knowledge, resources,
engagement, and diagnostic features.

This update will both install the plug-in by default into python-django-horizon
and will harden the plug-in's JavaScript

All Red Hat OpenStack users are advised to upgrade to these updated packages
which address these issues.
